name: Triflupromazine
aliases: 2-(Trifluoromethyl)promazine, Fluopromazine, trifluopromazine, Triflupromazin, Triflupromazina, Triflupromazinum, Vesprin®
summary: Triflupromazine (Vesprin) is an antipsychotic medication of the phenothiazine class. Among different effects of triflupromazine indication for use of this drug is severe emesis and severe hiccups. Due to its potential side effects it is not gold standard in antiemetic therapy.
